description.value: West B Pizza is a Vancouver pizzeria on West Broadway serving a creative lineup of pies including fusion options like Paneer Masala and Vietnamese Chilli Chicken alongside classics and pasta dishes. The shop offers indoor seating and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for cyclists along the busy Broadway corridor. A range of vegetarian options and sides like peri peri wings and fries round out the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched from the OSM URL (pizzamiaonline.square.site) and confirms the business name, address (407 West Broadway, Vancouver, BC V5Y 1R4), and phone number (604) 714-0037. The site prominently redirects users to a newer ordering website (westbpizza.square.site), and all menu items show 'Out of stock,' suggesting the listed OSM website is no longer the primary URL. Vegetarian options are confirmed from multiple explicit menu items; takeout/online ordering is confirmed by the 'Order now' functionality. No evidence exists on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycle-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM website URL (pizzamiaonline.square.site) is outdated: the fetched page explicitly directs customers to a new website at westbpizza.square.site, and all menu items show 'Out of stock' on the old site. OSM website tag should be updated to https://westbpizza.square.site.
OSM tags use 'website' and 'website:menu' pointing to the same old Square site; the new ordering URL (westbpizza.square.site) is not reflected in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant at a confirmed Vancouver address with active online presence and hours. Useful to touring cyclists as a food stop on the West Broadway corridor.
